notes.title: EP full of covers coming May 25th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590786/587bf80e9f7fd7ddcca94559b019fd2bf8ed9a2c.png[/img]

This EP in a long line of forthcoming EPs is a cover album of four of my personal favourite tracks, rearranged into classical melodies in a somewhat indie (as much as I hate to say it) style. The tracks include
- Protagonism Theme
- Megalovania
- In The End by Linking Park
- Requiem for a Dream theme / Lux Aeterna

Click [url=https://brokentoolsgames.com/2021/04/25/second-ep-coming-may-25/] HERE [/url] for more info!

notes.title: Update: Way Nicer Save System!
notes.content:
Just published a big update for the demo that makes it easier and more fun to replay the game. 
- Multiple saves/loads.
- See the entire map of different choices you have.
- Directly revisit previous scenes to try other story branches.

notes.title: Demo Coming Out On July 30th!
notes.content:
This took a while.
Longer than I care to admit, but each of you knows how long you've been waiting.
The Demo is FINALLY pretty much done and I'm finishing up some organizational stuff and minor bug fixes. It goes public on Jul 30, 2020 @ 7:00pm PDT. 
So like, you know, make sure not to miss it! Cause if you do, that's not on me anymore, that's on you


P. S. Apparently Steam Community is a thing? And there are people following me on it?
I kinda feel ashamed that I only now found out about this. My bad :(
